name: hcapp_getKennelOfficialTrails
description: The kennel page's full-screen trail map (E5.F6.S6). Rowset 0: every official (hare's) trail of the kennel's runs that have ENDED — start + 4 hours, via HC6.KennelOfficialTrails — newest first, the lanes JSON decompressed inline. Rowset 1 (since 2026-10-03): the START POINT of every visible, non-deleted run of the kennel, past and future, from the trail-independent Sync* latitude/longitude the app shows as the run's location; runs with no usable position (NULL, 0/0, outside range, or the app's -2/-2 'cleared' sentinel) are left out. Fetched when the map opens, never synced; apps before build 1442 read rowset 0 only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 146, @param NULL). No permission gate — any authenticated user may read any kennel's trails.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel. NULL is not rejected: both rowsets come back empty.

rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail alone, no envelope. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: OfficialTrails
rowsets.description: One row per ended run that holds an official trail (HC6.KennelOfficialTrails: OfficialTrailGzip not NULL, deleted = 0, removed = 0, IsVisible = 1, start + 4h <= now), ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt DESC.

columns.name: EventStartLocal
columns.description: HC.Event.EventStartLocal — the run's wall-clock start (persisted computed column).

columns.name: OfficialTrail
columns.description: DECOMPRESS(HC.Event.OfficialTrailGzip) as text: the lanes JSON, points [lat, lon] or [lat, lon, t].

rowsets.name: StartPoints
rowsets.description: One row per visible, non-deleted, non-removed run of the kennel with a usable start position, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt DESC. Apps before 1442 ignore it.

columns.name: Lat
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLatitude (FbLatitude when UseFbLatLon = 1, else Latitude) cast to DECIMAL(9,6).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 71-73, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.issue: Sentinel positions filtered by magic values
codeSmells.detail: Lines 65-66 exclude 0/0 and -2/-2 as 'no position' sentinels written by the app. The meaning of -2/-2 lives only in this WHERE clause and the app; a third sentinel would need both sides changed.
There is no parameter check: a NULL or unknown kennel returns two empty rowsets and nothing is logged, so a client bug that drops the id looks like a kennel with no trails.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
